name: Seated Pose with Raised Left Knee and Extended Right Leg
name_es: Pose sentada con rodilla izquierda elevada y pierna derecha extendida
pose_description:
base: Seated on both sit bones, with slight posterior pelvic tilt and slight rotation toward the subject's right. Weight distributed across the pelvis, with no weight borne by the feet.
left_leg: Marked hip and knee flexion (approximately 90–100 degrees). Thigh raised, shin nearly vertical; left foot planted flat on the ground in front of the torso, toes pointing forward.
right_leg: Extended toward the subject's right and slightly forward. Hip slightly to moderately flexed, knee slightly bent; right foot resting on its outer edge with the sole partially visible and toes pointing outward.
torso: Upright, with slight lateral lean toward the subject's right and slight torsion.
shoulders: Right shoulder lower and relaxed; left shoulder slightly advanced.
right_arm: Hanging beside the torso, elbow nearly fully extended with slight flexion. Right hand supported near the ground beside the right hip, fingers relaxed.
left_arm: Crosses toward the left leg, elbow moderately flexed, forearm resting across the thigh. Left hand resting on the left shin with fingers extended toward the ankle.
head: Facing forward, with a slight turn and lateral tilt toward the subject's right.
